item.title: MUSIC: Mr Chocho - Joy Is Coming Remix feat. Dipphlow
item.description: Mr Chocho's journey has been a rough ride which is filled with both pains and lessons. After a brief depression as a result of losing his grandmother that took care of him all his life, he released the tribute song "Joy is Coming" as a proclamation that he will find joy again.Mr Chocho is the originator of Joy Is Coming as he released his single Joy is Coming before it was copied by Fido. "Joy is Coming" is more than just a song but also a prayer of faith from a soul filled with extreme sadness.
